function: Excluded for system: DDPG power allocation across HARQ-IR rounds in ISAC, but the link has one antenna at transmitter and receiver, no RIS (p. 2).
notes: Title and DOI checked on p. 1 (Throughput Maximization of HARQ-IR for ISAC, 10.1109/LCOMM.2025.3526865). Steps 1 to 5 pass: a research letter; DDPG learns the transmit power of each HARQ round (p. 1, 4), a physical-layer decision under communication outage and sensing detection constraints, which is an area 5 function; quantitative results on p. 5. Step 6 fails: p. 2: "the CU is equipped with a single antenna and the BS is equipped with separate transmit and receive antennas"; every channel is a scalar coefficient (p. 2: "denotes the channel coefficient from the BS to the CU"), the action is a scalar power (p. 4), and no RIS or antenna array appears anywhere in the letter. If the reviewer reads HARQ power allocation as link adaptation, the reason would be function instead of system.
